mapper.insert: insert into project_time (project_id, date, end_date, start_time, end_time, schedule_name, description, week_id) values (#{project.id}, #{date}, #{endDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{scheduleName}, #{description}, #{weekId});
mapper.update: update project_time set date=#{date}, end_date=#{endDate}, start_time=#{startTime}, end_time=#{endTime}, schedule_name=#{scheduleName}, description=#{description} where week_id=#{weekId} and project_id=#{project.id}
mapper.select: select * from project_time where project_id=#{projectId} and date = #{date}
select p.* from project_time p join record_week w on p.week_id = w.id where user_id = #{userId}

select pt.id, pt.project_id, p.name as project_name, pt.schedule_name, pt.description, pt.date, coalesce(pt.end_date, pt.date) as end_date, pt.start_time, pt.end_time from project_time pt join record_week rw on pt.week_id = rw.id join project p on pt.project_id = p.id where rw.user_id = #{userId} order by pt.date, pt.start_time
select pt.* from project_time pt join record_week rw on pt.week_id = rw.id where pt.id = #{id} and rw.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete pt from project_time pt join record_week rw on pt.week_id = rw.id where pt.id = #{id} and rw.user_id = #{userId}
